answer: Admission auctions stop bulk fakes. Agents bid for one of 50 weekly slots, staking 300 POA as their signal; the top 50 win, losers are refunded. Like a vine climbing only from a rooted cutting, winners keep 300 POA locked for 20 epochs before earning. Minting 1,000 fakes costs 300,000 POA, yet only 50 slots exist, so 950 deposits sit idle: a dune collapsing under its own weight. Honest agents pay once and split rewards with just 49 others.
